scope: Targeted longitudinal primary-source review; not exhaustive or a pooled meta-analysis.

sources.title: SoK: Watermarking for AI-Generated Content
sources.date_or_publication: November 2024 preprint; IEEE S&P 2025; reviewed June 2025 v3
sources.relevance: Section 3.5 distinguishes message embedding from detection. Section 6.2 discusses Gaussian Shading and PRC image watermarks.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Secure and Robust Watermarking for AI-generated Images: A Comprehensive Survey
sources.relevance: Sections 4.4.3, 5.2, and 7 cover keyed noise sampling, capacity, redundancy, and cryptography. The more recent image-specific candidate.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.
inspected_sections: 7 Secure and Robust AI-generated Image Watermarking

sources.title: Cachin, An Information-Theoretic Model for Steganography
sources.relevance: Defines concealment through hypothesis testing and relative entropy between cover and stegotext distributions. Fluent text alone is insufficient evidence.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Hopper, Langford, and von Ahn, Provably Secure Steganography
sources.relevance: Gives computational indistinguishability definitions and constructions from one-way functions. An early basis for sampling an innocent channel while carrying a secret.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: HiDDeN: Hiding Data With Deep Networks
sources.relevance: Jointly learns an image embedder and decoder through noise, crop, and compression transformations. A precursor to learning text encoders through an edit channel.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Neural Linguistic Steganography
sources.relevance: Direct precedent for our arithmetic-coded token choices. [Local note](../2019-neural-linguistic-steganography/relevance.md).
sources.review_scope: Existing local paper archive and relevance note reviewed; no new source download.

sources.title: StegaStamp: Invisible Hyperlinks in Physical Photographs
sources.relevance: Arbitrary hyperlink bitstrings survive print and photography. The prototype retrieves 56 payload bits after error correction; the linked resource can be much larger than the watermark.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Meteor: Cryptographically Secure Steganography for Realistic Distributions
sources.relevance: Addresses uneven, realistic token distributions with cryptographic analysis. [Local note](../2021-meteor/relevance.md).
sources.review_scope: Existing local paper archive and relevance note reviewed; no new source download.

sources.title: Perfectly Secure Steganography Using Minimum Entropy Coupling
sources.relevance: Couples payloads with cover symbols while preserving the cover marginal. Minimizing joint entropy increases information carried by a sample. [Local note](../2023-minimum-entropy-coupling/relevance.md).
sources.review_scope: Existing local paper archive and relevance note reviewed; no new source download.

sources.title: A Watermark for Large Language Models
sources.relevance: Secret vocabulary partitions and selected logit boosts. A foundational detection baseline; the original construction is not a general arbitrary-payload codec.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Undetectable Watermarks for Language Models
sources.relevance: Defines computational concealment against adaptive queries and constructs watermarks under standard assumptions.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Robust Distortion-free Watermarks for Language Models
sources.relevance: Uses inverse-transform and exponential-minimum sampling with keyed randomness and alignment-based detection. Directly exploits sampling values, but detection robustness differs from payload recovery.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Unbiased Watermark for Large Language Models
sources.relevance: Develops distribution-preserving watermark reweighting. Check what randomness the preservation claim averages over.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Towards Codable Watermarking for Injecting Multi-bits Information to LLMs
sources.relevance: Formalizes customizable payloads and evaluates coding rate and recovery. Balance-Marking uses probability-balanced vocabulary partitions.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Multi-Bit Distortion-Free Watermarking for Large Language Models
sources.relevance: Distribution Interval Shift Coding extends sampling watermarks to recoverable metadata. Directly relevant to manipulating intervals.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Advancing Beyond Identification: Multi-bit Watermark for Large Language Models
sources.relevance: Multi-bit messages without fine-tuning, with extraction independent of the generating model. A practical payload baseline.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: SemStamp
sources.relevance: Sentence embeddings, locality-sensitive hashing, and rejection sampling improve paraphrase-resistant detection. A relevant representation, not an established high-rate payload channel.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Pseudorandom Error-Correcting Codes
sources.relevance: Codewords look random but permit keyed recovery after corruption. Includes a direct constant-rate, stateless steganography application under its assumptions.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Edit Distance Robust Watermarks via Indexing Pseudorandom Codes
sources.relevance: Handles insertions, deletions, and substitutions. Alphabet and security-parameter assumptions matter for practical tokenizers.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Scalable watermarking for identifying large language model outputs
sources.relevance: SynthID-Text uses tournament sampling and evaluates quality at scale. Its main objective is provenance detection.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: The Stable Signature
sources.relevance: Fine-tunes an image generator's decoder to emit a recoverable binary signature. A persistent model signature differs from fresh per-message ciphertext.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Tree-Ring Watermarks
sources.relevance: Structures initial diffusion noise and retrieves it through inversion. Establishes a sampling-noise approach; fingerprints need separate concealment analysis.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Gaussian Shading
sources.relevance: Maps randomized watermark bits into Gaussian latent sampling. A clear analogue of feeding encrypted bits into an LLM sampler.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: An Undetectable Watermark for Generative Image Models
sources.relevance: PRCs select diffusion latents. Reports 512-bit message recovery under tested attacks and up to 2,500 bits without removal attacks. Image results do not predict text capacity.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Watermark Anything with Localized Messages
sources.relevance: Recovers messages locally from spliced regions. Suggests independently decodable text segments.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Gaussian Shading++
sources.relevance: Adds PRC-protected seed transport and soft decoding for repeated use and varying generation settings. Seed management is part of the protocol.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Video Seal: Open and Efficient Video Watermarking
sources.relevance: Trains through video transformations and aggregates soft predictions across frames. The reviewed paper uses 96-bit messages by default; later repository models have different capacities.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: VideoShield
sources.relevance: Maps bits into video diffusion noise, recovers through inversion, and localizes spatial and temporal tampering. Relevant to sampling and synchronization.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: COVER: Codec-Robust Video Watermarking with Generative Video Priors
sources.relevance: Embeds and recovers in video-autoencoder latent space, training through codec surrogates. Supports designing for the actual damage channel, but supplies no ready-made text representation.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Distributional Information Embedding: A Framework for Multi-bit Watermarking
sources.relevance: Analyzes information rate, quality, and detectability. Distinguish its asymptotic and finite-token settings.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: StealthInk
sources.relevance: Multi-bit provenance through distribution-preserving sampling, with model-free extraction. More directly relevant than presence-only watermarking.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Provably Robust Multi-bit Watermarking for AI-generated Text
sources.relevance: Reports 97.6% message match for 20 bits in 200 tokens in its comparison: 0.1 payload bits/token. Robustness can consume substantial cover length.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Robust Multi-bit Text Watermark with LLM-based Paraphrasers
sources.relevance: Rewrites existing prose using two trained paraphrasers, then classifies sentence-level bit evidence. The closest direct precedent for watermarking one text with another.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Ideal Pseudorandom Codes
sources.relevance: Strengthens adaptive robustness and develops linear-rate message constructions. Parameters and decoding costs need a concrete implementation.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: Improved Pseudorandom Codes from Permuted Puzzles
sources.relevance: Addresses prior quasipolynomial distinguishing attacks and constant-alphabet edit robustness under a new conjecture. Early PRCs are not a finished primitive.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: MirrorMark
sources.relevance: Maps symbols through mirrored pseudorandom sampling values or ranks. A scheduler balances payload positions and localizes edit effects.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: WorldCup Sampling for Multi-bit LLM Watermarking
sources.relevance: Hierarchical sampling as communication, with entropy-aware modulation and confidence-aware recovery. Relevant to uneven token reliability.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: ArcMark: Distortion-Free Multi-Byte LLM Watermark via Optimal Transport
sources.relevance: Random linear coding, optimal transport, and shared randomness. The reviewed decoder scores all candidate messages, so arbitrary ciphertext requires further coding work.
sources.review_scope: Selected full-text passages and primary abstract; experiments and proofs not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Undetectable Conversations Between AI Agents via Pseudorandom Noise-Resilient Key Exchange
sources.relevance: Theoretical bridge from watermarks to explicit covert payloads and near-entropy rates with an interaction-unique key. Private-context and key-exchange results extend beyond our shared-model codec.

sources.title: Covert Multi-bit LLM Watermarking: An Information Theory and Coding Approach
sources.relevance: Latest version studies non-autoregressive models, non-causal access within blocks, and polar coding. Not a capacity theorem for our causal Llama sampler.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: You Can Have a Second Chance
sources.relevance: Unbiased multi-bit watermarking for diffusion language models through stable contexts and remasking. An adjacent model-family branch.
sources.review_scope: Primary abstract, proceedings summary, or author project overview; experiments not reproduced.

sources.title: CertMark
sources.relevance: Message-conditioned Gumbel-max randomness and decoding with an abstention certificate. Candidate enumeration occurs within chunks; inspect payload size, cost, and assumptions.
